subject.statement: Rodrigo Rato, exdirector del FMI, fue condenado en 2024 por delitos contra la Hacienda Pública.

summary: Rodrigo Rato, former Managing Director of the IMF (2004‑2007), was convicted in December 2024 by a Madrid court for tax crimes, money laundering and corruption, including three offences against the Treasury (delitos contra la Hacienda Pública). He was sentenced to more than four years imprisonment. No evidence shows he has been acquitted or had those charges dropped. In July 2026 he was ordered to appear as a witness in the Gürtel trial. The verdict is TRUE with high confidence.

findings.statement: Rodrigo Rato is the former Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
Rodrigo Rato served as Managing Director of the IMF from 2004 to 2007.

On 2024-12-20 a Madrid court sentenced Rodrigo Rato to more than four years in prison for tax crimes, money laundering and corruption, including three offences against the Treasury (delitos contra la Hacienda Pública).
After 2020, Rodrigo Rato's legal proceedings culminated in a December 2024 conviction for tax fraud, money laundering and corruption.
The conviction indicates that Rodrigo Rato has not been acquitted or had charges dropped regarding offences against the Treasury.
On 2026-07-29 the Audiencia Nacional ordered Rodrigo Rato to appear as a witness in the Gürtel trial.
